fields.name: Result handler
fields.definition: A delegate matching `QueryResultModelHandler<TArg, TModel>` that turns one connection's command results, its data reader and parameter collection, into a model. It receives a model instance to populate, the shard id (default for non-sharded databases), the query name, an optional caller-supplied argument, the connection description and the logger. It is invoked once per connection and, in a fan-out query, concurrently on many threads, so it must be thread-safe. The Mapper supplies ready-made handlers used by the Map methods; Query methods take a caller-written one.
